name: Conventions page lists seeded candidates and opens the create-skill modal
description: Loads /conventions, confirms the seeded candidates render with their grounded file:line evidence and measured adherence, accepts one, and opens the 'Create skill from conventions' modal. Deterministic — the candidates are seeded, so no model call is made. Accepting a candidate WRITES, so the flow reverts it at the end (close the modal, Deselect all) and re-asserts the empty counter: the flow must be re-runnable against a stack it does not own.

steps.label: scan header reports what was sampled
measured adherence is shown, not just confidence
draft is pre-filled from the accepted rule
close the modal without saving a skill
counter is back to its seeded state
